# Kinesis Data Streams

Write and read ordered shard records and feed local Lambda or Firehose consumers.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `kinesis` |
| Signing name | `kinesis` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2013-12-02` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 31 of 45 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#kinesis-data-streams) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No SubscribeToShard enhanced fan-out delivery or throughput enforcement.
- Resource policies, production record-size settings and warm throughput are outside the subset.
- KMS encryption settings are stored without encrypting stream records.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
